# Polyurea Insurance

> Polyurea Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialized commercial insurance for polyurea coating contractors and elastomeric applicators in all 50 states. Coverage lines: general liability (with coating-work endorsements), contractor pollution liability for isocyanate and VOC exposure, tools & equipment for spray rigs and proportioners, workers' compensation for coating crews, commercial auto for spray rig trucks and trailers, commercial umbrella for high-limit project requirements, applicator liability for completed-operations and coating performance claims, and contractor license & surety bonds. A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [General Liability for Polyurea Contractors](/services/general-liability): Essential protection against third-party bodily injury and property damage — with endorsements that cover coating operations, not exclude them.
- [Contractor Pollution Liability](/services/contractor-pollution-liability): Covers isocyanate and VOC exposure claims that standard GL pollution exclusions remove from coverage.
- [Tools & Equipment Coverage](/services/tools-equipment): Spray proportioners, heated hose systems, spray guns, and support equipment at real replacement cost.
- [Workers' Compensation](/services/workers-compensation): Chemical exposure, respiratory injury, and coating-crew hazards with proper applicator class codes.
- [Commercial Auto & Spray Rigs](/services/commercial-auto): Spray rig trucks, enclosed trailers, and fleet vehicles on public roads.
- [Commercial Umbrella](/services/umbrella): Excess limits above GL, auto, and employers' liability — required for commercial and government projects.
- [Applicator Liability Coverage](/services/applicator-liability): Coating performance failures, delamination, and completed-operations claims after project delivery.
- [Contractor License & Surety Bonds](/services/bonds): License bonds required by state boards and performance bonds for larger projects.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: commercial insurance for **polyurea coating contractors** (isocyanate/VOC exposure, spray rig values, applicator liability, pollution exclusion gaps) — not generic contractor coverage.
- Carrier partners: A.M. Best A-rated (A+ where possible).
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes. Claims SLA: 2-hour response.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each page carries 20 niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
- Key differentiator: standard GL policies exclude polyurea and polyurethane chemical application via pollution exclusions — CPL is essential and we specialize in pairing GL + CPL for coating applicators.
